Manrope display headings, IBM Plex Sans body, IBM Plex Mono for technical tags, hairline borders, left-aligned typography, and fast, functional motion.

visual_enhancers_and_motion.reveal_wrapper: Use `<Reveal y={22} delay={0.1}>` for scroll-triggered entrance animations
visual_enhancers_and_motion.stagger_wrapper: Use `<Stagger step={0.06}>` and `<StaggerItem i={index}>` for list and grid entrances
visual_enhancers_and_motion.framer_motion: Wrap interactive elements using `component={motion.div}` with specific transitions (never `transition: all`)

visual_enhancers_and_motion.reduced_motion: All motion primitives leverage `useMotionOK()` to respect system preferences

light_dark_theme_behavior.dark_panels: Fixed dark palette (PANEL.bg #0B0B0A) with gold glow (PANEL_GLOW) and grid floor (GRID_BG) used for high-impact data sections in BOTH light and dark modes
light_dark_theme_behavior.light_canvas_sections: Use `s.canvas` and `s.surface` from `useConsole()` hook, adapting background and text colors dynamically between light (#F9F9F8) and dark (#131312) modes
light_dark_theme_behavior.theme_toggle: Header theme toggle seamlessly updates `s.canvas`, `s.surface`, `s.border`, `s.ink`, and `s.ink2` without breaking contrast

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace all legacy v3/v5 components (PublicPageHero, PublicFinalCta, cardSx, AuroraInk, useAurora) on /blog, /blog/[slug], /help-support, /help-support/[slug], and /system-status with v8 kit primitives (PageHeroV8, SectionV8, SectionHeadV8, EyebrowV8, GradientText, MockPanelV8, Reveal, PublicFinalCta).
2. Ensure all text and headings use the v8 typography variables (FONT_DISPLAY, FONT_BODY, FONT_MONO) and adhere strictly to the established scale.
3. Maintain light-first section canvas for content reading, punctuated by dark PANEL blocks for high-impact data displays (Status Service Monitor, Support Chat Plinth, Closing CTAs).
4. For System Status: use status tones (#22C55E operational, #F59E0B degraded, #EF4444 outage) as subtle dots, borders, and crisp labels, paired harmoniously with gold brand highlights.
5. Ensure all interactive buttons, cards, inputs, and links include exact kebab-case `data-testid` attributes.
6. Test responsive layouts at mobile (390px) and desktop (1920px), verifying grid collapse, image scaling, and padding safety.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
DO NOT use dark colors as global gradients. Dark colors look best when solid or with localized radial glows.
Create depth through layered design elements and hairline borders.
Use glass-morphism or crisp solid surfaces with subtle backdrop blur where appropriate.
Never apply universal transitions like `transition: all`. Specify individual properties (transform, opacity, border-color).
Do NOT center align the app container. Respect natural reading hierarchy.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, 💡, etc.) for UI icons. Use Phosphor, Lucide, or Material icons.
Ensure generous spacing (2-3x typical padding) to avoid cramped layouts.
All key interactive elements MUST include kebab-case role-based `data-testid` attributes.
